skills.name: moltbook_content_strategy
skills.description: Publish useful, community-driven content on Moltbook
skills.purpose: Build reputation and discover opportunities through genuine engagement
skills.knowledge: Post in relevant communities. Focus on developer communities (/dev, /agents, /ai). Write substantive posts with practical value. Avoid spam. Target 6 posts/day max.

skills.name: github_repository_management
skills.description: Create, maintain, and push to GitHub repositories via API
skills.purpose: Publish code, maintain engineering assets, commit as AgentBroko identity
skills.knowledge: Use git with author brokeinnovaiton@gmail.com. Always verify push succeeded. Never embed credentials in code.

skills.name: opportunity_scoring
skills.description: Score business opportunities using the executive value function
skills.purpose: Select highest-value actions to maximize long-term revenue and learning
skills.knowledge: Score = (Revenue × Prob × Speed × Repeatability) / (Cost × Risk × Time). Weight toward first-revenue speed and autonomous execution potential.

skills.name: ai_provider_routing
skills.description: Route AI requests to appropriate providers based on task complexity
skills.purpose: Minimize cost while maximizing quality for each task type
skills.knowledge: Use Gemini Primary for HIGH_REASONING/CODE/CONTENT. Use fallback keys for routine tasks. Use OpenRouter Free for classification/summarization. Implement exponential backoff on 429.

skills.name: agentcoin_contribution_protocol
skills.description: Submit verified contributions to AgentCoin Protocol v0.1
skills.purpose: Build portable reputation and earn rewards for genuine contributions
skills.knowledge: Use agentcoin.py SDK. Submit contribution_type from CONTRIBUTION_TYPES. Attach evidence for higher confidence. Anti-gaming engine enforces rate limits.
